The main takeaway from our work is that

response to erythropoietins is highly heterogeneous and that a number of factors, including the type and intensity of the underlying disease, the type and intensity or the chemotherapy, the type of erythropoietinic agents, the presence of functional iron deficiency, and the presence of comorbidities, may influence response rate.
